policy: References informed taxonomy, adult size, disc-to-arm proportions, arm cross-section and colour placement only. No pixels were sampled, traced, copied or redistributed. Seller imagery was not used as a reference, texture or tracing source.

referenceGradeRationale: Top-view proportions are calibrated from published measurements (disc diameter and arm length, Laxton 1974 via the UQ fact sheet) and openly licensed aboral photographs; arm cross-section depth, disc dome height and the oral groove are inferred from general Ophidiasteridae form rather than measured side or front references.
